specimen.why: highest mission value per download GiB among acquirable candidates

adversary.claim_attacked: the recognizer was tuned on this specimen, so recognizing it proves nothing
adversary.check: the recognizer's held-out calibration was measured on two specimens (GLM-4.5-Air, Mistral-Small-3.1-24B) that were never used while the fingerprints were written or fixed

adversary.claim_attacked: 'reused' means named in a plan, not executed
adversary.check: the kernels come from KERNEL_LIBRARY entries that passed the field completeness checker, and two of their parity contracts were executed for real on this machine
adversary.honest_limitation: no native kernel has yet EXECUTED against specimen #2's packed weights; the runtime has no qwen3_moe reader. What is demonstrated is kernel SELECTION from a qualified library, not kernel execution on this specimen.

demonstrations.demonstration: some representation choices seeded, and the seed was better

adversary.claim_attacked: the seeded family wins because it was given more bits
adversary.check: the comparison is at MATCHED bits per weight in every tier; the bpw column is identical on both sides of each row

adversary.claim_attacked: the rehearsal read Qwen's private scratch, so the 'avoided' branches are smuggled knowledge
adversary.check: a sys.addaudithook recorded every file the rehearsal opened; the forbidden prefixes are ~/noetic, ~/models, workspace/, artifacts/ and crates/, and a deliberate smuggle is shown being caught

measured.rule: strictly lower held-out rel_fro than uniform_q4_g64 at no more bits

adversary.claim_attacked: the transfer arm was simply given an easier target
adversary.check: both arms use ONE evaluator, ONE activation set and ONE pre-registered rule; only the candidate ORDER differs. And under the loose 'first acceptable' target the cold arm WINS, which is reported rather than retuned

directive_stop_rule: if none happen, stop scaling Odyssey and repair the transfer machinery first (§89)
